description: Stadt Zürich (City of Zürich, Geomatik + Vermessung and Statistik Stadt Zürich) publishes the geodata of the zoning plan and supplementary plans under the city building ordinance, an extract of the city's restrictions-on-public-land-ownership cadastre; the portal says the dataset is a legally required part of the building and zoning regulations, and lists a 1999 version as a separate dataset. Coverage: the City of Zürich; the portal record was last modified on 2026-09-29. Format and access: DXF, GPKG, JSON, Shapefile, WFS, WMS, WMTS, downloadable without registration from the City of Zürich open data portal; the portal also serves the metadata through a public API. Licence (read on the portal page on 2026-09-29): Creative Commons CCZero; cost: free. Caveats: the files were not opened, so the zone classes and attributes are unconfirmed; the dataset is an information extract and the legal reference is the official cadastre; the cantonal versions of the same cadastre are separate portal datasets. Simulation uses: zoning as a land-use scenario input for urban growth, exposure and infrastructure demand models, and to check where development is allowed in flood or hazard zones. Related catalogue records: OpenStreetMap (data-openstreetmap).
